correctness.rationale: The reverse balanced-deck count process is an exact simple random-walk bridge. Conditional Bernoulli variance yields the exact finite-m martingale variance. Hypergeometric sub-Gaussian bounds give uniform fourth moments and negligible endpoint truncation, upgrading bridge weak convergence to first/second moment convergence. A Gaussian two-time absolute-moment formula and two explicit positive-integrand evaluations give E A²=2log2-1/2. Previously established two-color score moment limits then yield the covariance. Exact rational enumeration through m=8 checks all finite identities; quadrature separately checks the two integrals. Source arxiv:2610.17479v1 Proposition 1.4 and arxiv:2303.04609v1 Theorem 9; verify_moments.py is standalone.
